pages.title: Meet Your Companion
pages.text: A tamed dragon can travel with you and learn from books. Once named and grown, it can fold its wings and join you in another form.$(br2)These pages help you care for fire, ice, and lightning companions.

pages.title: Preparing to Transform
pages.text: Name your dragon, reach stage three and 300 knowledge, then try human form.$(br2)Stand close, empty both hands, Shift-right-click, and add materials under Knowledge Level. Keep $(l:dragonmaid:learning/books)reading and advancing$(/l) to unlock more accessory slots.

pages.title: Finding the Right Chapter
pages.text: Before setting out, read $(l:dragonmaid:behavior/commands)The Keeper's Commands$(/l). To travel in another shape, turn to $(l:dragonmaid:forms/transformation)Taking Human Form$(/l).$(br2)If your companion falls, read $(l:dragonmaid:care/injury)Wounds and Stone$(/l): a severe injury can still heal.
